hooks.description: Runs node --check on every JS file and validates hook JSON whenever the agent saves or creates a file in this repo. Follows the official Kiro hooks v1 schema (kiro.dev/docs/hooks/, updated 2026-11-15). Command actions receive the event as JSON on STDIN; this script ignores STDIN and validates the whole js/ tree, which is fast and deterministic.
hooks.name: Validate JS on save

hooks.description: Same validation when the agent creates a new JS/JSON file.
hooks.name: Validate JS on create
